name: workflow-canvas
title: Workflow Canvas
description: A node-and-wire editor for chaining generation steps: draggable step cards with an icon tile, title, detail and setting chips, wires drawn by dragging between connection points, pan and zoom, an Add step menu, Tidy up (automatic left-to-right layout), Remove, and the lime Run button with its live credit cost. Dragging and wiring come from React Flow (@xyflow/react) and the layout from dagre. Takes the step types, optional starting steps and connections, and onChange and onRun callbacks.

meta.use_when: People chain several generation steps (such as prompt and reference into a model, then upscale) and need to see, rewire and run the pipeline on a board
